obligations.summary: Where a market surveillance authority finds that a compliant high-risk AI system still presents a risk to health, safety, fundamental rights, or public interest, it shall require the relevant operator to take all appropriate measures to eliminate that risk without undue delay within a prescribed period.

The provider or other relevant operator shall ensure that corrective action is taken in respect of all affected AI systems made available on the Union market within the timeline prescribed by the market surveillance authority.

Member States shall immediately inform the Commission and other Member States of any finding under paragraph 1, including all details necessary to identify the AI system, its origin and supply chain, the nature of the risk, and the national measures taken.

The Commission shall without undue delay consult with the Member States concerned and relevant operators, evaluate the national measures taken, and decide whether those measures are justified, proposing other appropriate measures where necessary.
The Commission shall immediately communicate its decision to the Member States concerned and to the relevant operators, and shall also inform the other Member States.
